_metadata.source: Lloyd's Market Association Joint War Committee — public listed areas
_metadata.note: JWC publishes its Hull War, Piracy, Terrorism and Related Perils Listed Areas document publicly; specific H&M rate quotes are between underwriter and broker. These listings identify zones where additional war-risk premia are applied — the premium range is indicative of market practice per IUMI / BIMCO public commentary and is not an actual underwritten rate.
_metadata.disclaimer: Indicative ranges. Actual rates are negotiated per vessel, per voyage, and per flag. This is NOT a quote service.

chokepointListings.notes: Persistently listed following the 2019 tanker incidents. Rates elevate when regional tensions spike.
Materially higher premia since the 2024 Houthi campaign. Many carriers reroute via Cape instead of paying.
